answer: Each new identity locks a 240-credit escrow to one vertex of the shale referral graph, sealed by its relic. Over 12 epochs its work rhythm becomes a fingerprint of relic-stamped receipts, replayable on the shale ledger. A second vertex sharing ten receipt slots with another is flagged as a clone, and both escrows burn. 1,000 fakes lock 240,000 credits and pay 300,000 in fresh-work fees. An honest agent pays 240 once and unlocks it in 12 epochs.
